finding.claim: measure-before-ticketing says a measurement spike is `loopctl plan spike` with its scripts kept in the spike (under .loop/), while docs-layout says a spike goes to .okf/ and that every script producing a number lives in .okf/prototypes/<name>/. The two kept rules give different homes for the same measurement.

fixes.change: A plan-risk spike stays in .loop/ through loopctl plan spike; analysis behind a cited number is a prototype in .okf/prototypes/<name>/.
The audience constraint now names prototypes for .okf/ and says a plan-risk spike stays with its ticket in .loop/, matching measure-before-ticketing.
